'''The Maze''' was a secret [[Pilot proving grounds|training area]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] to familiarize new [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] with Rebel [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. Based out of an [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] which moved location regularly, pilots were required to negotiate a series of gates and targets within a time limit. The course used [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] technology to simulate damage to starfighters and pilots had the opportunity to try a variety of starfighters, including the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]], [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]], [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing]] and [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing]]. During his first run through the Maze, Rebel pilot [[Dev]] accidentally made a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump to an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] training area in the [[Senex system/Legends|Senex system]].
